_comment: Default changed-file to test-file mapping table. map_version is the format version. Each rule maps one source glob to one or more test globs. Rules are evaluated in order and ALL matching rules contribute: a changed file that matches several rules maps to the union of their test globs. The table is additive, never first-match-wins. This is a generic starting point; a project overrides it by pointing commit_scope_map_file at its own map, not by editing this shipped copy.
